abstract: Two rare cases of cystic lesions with spontaneous radiographic resolution are presented. One is a 21-year-old man with a mediastinal seminoma containing a cystic lesion within the neoplasm that disappeared spontaneously on subsequent chest radiography and computed tomography. Another is a 65-year-old man with a pericardial cyst that also disappeared in subsequent chest radiography. The possible mechanisms for such rare occurrences are discussed.
abstract_ja: 2例の稀な嚢胞性病変が自然に画像上消失した症例を報告する。1例は21歳男性の縦隔セミノーマ内に生じた嚢胞性病変で、その後の胸部X線検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で自然に消失した。もう1例は65歳男性の心膜嚢胞で、同様に後の胸部X線検査で消失した。このような稀な現象の考えられる機序について考察する。
